## What this region is

The thin, untemplated dispatch lane for non-email channels, which renders a payload for a recipient and hands it to a per-ContactType adapter, and the single Contact model where every owner's addresses and handles live, validated and canonicalized by a per-type registry.

## What it exists for

- Send a message to users or a contact (untemplated vs templated email)
- Register or look up the sender for a contact channel
- Pick recipients and render per-recipient content
- Store, parse and validate a contact address or handle
- Normalize or parse a contact URL or email string

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Send an email to the user → email-delivery
- Save an email template → email-templates
- Can this rule read that field → email-lens
- Send an email or notification after this write → app-events-webhooks
- Use a different provider in prod than locally → adapters-integrations
